name: StellarLite_ICT_EA
summary: This EA implements ICT (Inner Circle Trader) concepts — specifically the Silver Bullet and 2022 Model strategies — for the Stellar Lite 5K prop firm challenge. It uses higher timeframe MA bias, liquidity sweeps, market structure shifts, fair value gaps, and NDOG/NWOG detection to find entries, with partial take-profits at 1:1, 2:1, and 3:1 R:R and trailing stop management.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了ICT（内圈交易者）概念，具体包括Silver Bullet和2022模型策略，专为Stellar Lite 5K挑战赛设计。它利用高周期均线偏向、流动性扫荡、市场结构转变、公允价值缺口和NDOG/NWOG检测来寻找入场点，并在1:1、2:1和3:1风险回报比设置分批止盈和跟踪止损管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ICT教学，使用高时间框架（H1）200周期SMA判断趋势方向，仅在趋势方向上寻找交易机会。入场条件要求同时满足五个条件：流动性扫荡（价格突破关键流动性水平后回归）、市场结构转变（MSS确认趋势反转）、公允价值缺口（FVG提供入场区域）、NDOG/NWOG确认（当日K线实体小于ATR阈值）、以及价格回踩至FVG区域内。Silver Bullet策略仅在纽约上午杀伤区（10:00-11:00）交易，2022模型则不限时段但使用反向流动性扫荡（诱导）作为额外确认。出场采用分批止盈：TP1处平50%仓位并将止损移至保本，TP2处再平25%并启动跟踪止损，剩余25%持有至TP3。仓位管理基于固定风险百分比（0.25%），根据止损距离自动计算手数。资金管理包含总回撤10%和日回撤5%的硬性限制，符合prop firm挑战规则。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on ICT concepts, using a higher timeframe (H1) 200-period SMA to determine trend direction, only trading in alignment with the trend. Entry requires five simultaneous conditions: a liquidity sweep (price piercing a key liquidity level then reversing), market structure shift (MSS confirming trend reversal), a fair value gap (FVG providing the entry zone), NDOG/NWOG confirmation (the current candle's range is within an ATR-based threshold), and price retracing into the FVG zone. The Silver Bullet strategy only trades during the NY AM Killzone (10:00-11:00), while the 2022 Model trades any time but uses inverse liquidity sweeps (inducement) for additional confirmation. Exits use partial take-profits: 50% closed at TP1 with SL moved to breakeven, 25% closed at TP2 with a trailing stop activated, and the remaining 25% held to TP3. Position sizing is based on a fixed risk percentage (0.25%) with lot size automatically calculated from the stop-loss distance. Money management enforces a 10% total drawdown and 5% daily drawdown hard limit, complying with prop firm challenge rules.

pros: 严格的资金管理：0.25%单笔风险、10%总回撤和5%日回撤限制，完全符合prop firm挑战规则
分批止盈策略合理：TP1平半仓锁利并移止损至保本，TP2再平25%启动跟踪止损，兼顾盈利保护与趋势跟随
多条件入场过滤：要求流动性扫荡+MSS+FVG+NDOG/NWOG五重确认，大幅降低虚假信号入场概率
高时间框架趋势过滤：使用H1 200SMA判断大方向，避免逆势交易
pros_en: Strict money management: 0.25% risk per trade, 10% total drawdown and 5% daily drawdown limits fully compliant with prop firm challenge rules
Well-structured partial take-profit: closes 50% at TP1 locking profit and moving SL to breakeven, then 25% at TP2 activating trailing stop, balancing profit protection with trend following
Multi-condition entry filter: requires liquidity sweep + MSS + FVG + NDOG/NWOG five-fold confirmation, significantly reducing false signal entries
Higher timeframe trend filter: uses H1 200 SMA for directional bias, avoiding counter-trend trades
cons: ATR指标句柄内存泄漏：CheckNDOG_NWOG每次调用都创建并释放iATR句柄，在频繁调用时造成资源浪费和潜在性能问题
流动性检测过于简化：FindNearestLiquidityLevel仅查找回溯期内的最高/最低点，未识别真正的结构性高低点（swing highs/lows），容易产生错误信号
市场结构转变（MSS）判断逻辑有缺陷：仅比较最近3根K线的收盘价与高低点，未考虑结构性突破的幅度和时间跨度，容易产生误判
FVG检测逻辑反转：买入FVG条件检查rates[i].high < rates[i-2].low，这意味着K线i的高点低于K线i-2的低点，这描述的是下跌缺口而非看涨FVG，逻辑与实际ICT定义不一致
每日回撤基准使用equity而非balance，与大多数prop firm的规则不一致（通常基于当日开仓balance）
单笔交易限制：positionInfo.SelectByMagic只检查是否存在该魔法号持仓，无法同时管理多个仓位
cons_en: ATR handle memory leak: CheckNDOG_NWOG creates and releases an iATR handle on every call, causing resource waste and potential performance issues with frequent invocations

Overly simplified liquidity detection: FindNearestLiquidityLevel only finds the highest/lowest point in the lookback period without identifying true structural swing highs/lows, easily producing false signals
Flawed MSS (Market Structure Shift) logic: only compares close/high/low of the last 3 bars without considering the magnitude or time span of structural breaks, prone to misjudgment
Inverted FVG detection logic: the buy FVG condition checks rates[i].high < rates[i-2].low, which describes a bearish gap rather than a bullish FVG, inconsistent with the actual ICT definition
Daily drawdown baseline uses equity instead of balance, inconsistent with most prop firm rules which typically use the day's opening balance
Single position limitation: positionInfo.SelectByMagic only checks for existence of a position with the magic number, unable to manage multiple simultaneous positions
improvements: 将ATR句柄移至OnInit()中初始化，避免每次CheckNDOG_NWOG调用时重复创建和销毁，提升性能并防止资源泄漏
改进流动性水平检测：实现真正的swing high/low识别算法（如使用分形或ZigZag方法），而非简单查找回溯期内的极值点
修正FVG检测逻辑：看涨FVG应为rates[i-2].high < rates[i].low（K线i-2的高点低于K线i的低点，中间K线未填补该区域），与ICT定义一致
增强MSS检测：增加结构突破的幅度阈值（如突破前结构点的ATR倍数），并考虑更大时间跨度的结构变化
支持多仓位管理：使用持仓遍历替代单仓位SelectByMagic，允许策略同时管理多个交易信号
improvements_en: Move ATR handle initialization to OnInit() to avoid repeated creation/destruction in CheckNDOG_NWOG, improving performance and preventing resource leaks
Improve liquidity level detection: implement proper swing high/low identification (e.g., fractal or ZigZag-based methods) instead of simply finding extremums in the lookback period
Fix FVG detection logic: bullish FVG should be rates[i-2].high < rates[i].low (gap between bar i-2 high and bar i low unfilled by the middle bar), consistent with ICT definition
Enhance MSS detection: add magnitude thresholds for structural breaks (e.g., ATR multiple beyond previous structure point) and consider longer time-span structural shifts
Support multi-position management: use position iteration instead of single-position SelectByMagic, allowing the strategy to manage multiple trade signals simultaneously

risk_points: FVG检测逻辑反转可能导致在错误方向入场，造成不必要的亏损
MSS检测过于简单可能产生虚假的结构突破信号，增加错误交易概率
每tick调用CheckNDOG_NWOG时重复创建ATR指标句柄，在高频tick环境下可能导致资源耗尽
每日回撤基准使用equity而非开仓balance，可能在实际prop firm评测中被判定违规
使用字符串比较进行时间过滤（timeStr >= SB_StartTime），在跨午夜时段可能失效
risk_points_en: Inverted FVG detection logic may cause entries in the wrong direction, leading to unnecessary losses
Overly simplistic MSS detection may produce false structural break signals, increasing erroneous trade probability
Repeated ATR indicator handle creation in CheckNDOG_NWOG on every tick may cause resource exhaustion in high-frequency tick environments
Daily drawdown baseline uses equity instead of opening balance, which may violate actual prop firm evaluation rules
String comparison for time filtering (timeStr >= SB_StartTime) may fail across midnight boundaries
